text.p: StarTronix International Inc on Tuesday said its subsidiary StarTronix Inc will layoff an unspecified number of employees.
In a statement, the company said the job cuts are part of its attempt to bring staffing into line with current needs.
Its decision was brought on by "uncertainty in funding" that gives the company the ability to meet its manufacturing commitments, StarTronix International said.

"Capital funding which we have been expecting for some time has not been received," said Greg Gilbert, chief executive officer. "We believe it is prudent to reduce our operating overhead, including salaries and wages which represent one-third of the company's overhead costs."
He added the company continues to look for sources of capital, and it believes the staff cuts will result in better management controls.
The company did not say how many jobs it was cutting from StarTronix staff, and a spokeswoman was not immediately available to comment.
